+        // be squeezed before a 2nd step starts binding (the sub-978 limiter).
+        let mut work: Vec<(usize, usize)> = widths
+            .iter()
+            .enumerate()
+            .map(|(i, r)| {
+                let w = 2 * (r[0].max(r[1]) as usize)
+                    + 2 * (r[2].max(r[3]) as usize)
+                    + r[4] as usize;
+                (i, w)
+            })
+            .collect();
+        work.sort_by(|a, b| b.1.cmp(&a.1));
